name: Rapunzel, Rapunzel
source:
A twisted retelling of Rapunzel, set among the stars.

You wake up blind, drifting through the void of space. There’s no map, no guide, only a way out… if you can find it.

[From [url=https://pajor.itch.io/rapunzel-rapunzel]Itch.io[/url]]
